settings.skyemuPathHint: Used as the default folder when downloading SkyEmu.
settings.languageHint: Switches both UI language and chis-burner-cmd output language.
settings.thermalPaperHint: Show the cutter and thermal paper under SkyEmu. When off, no bottom inset is reserved.
settings.chipEraseHint: Erase the entire Flash before burning.
settings.unlockPpbHint: Clear persistent protection bits before burning.
settings.verifyAfterHint: Read back and verify data after burning.
settings.voltageHint: GBA always uses 3.3V; GB/GBC can auto-detect or use 3.3V / 5V manually.
settings.voltageManualDesc: Applies when auto detect is off
settings.cartridgeStageHint: Show the identified cartridge above the main card. When off, no top inset is reserved.
settings.cartridgeStickersHint: Show the sticker shelf when Logs is open. Requires cartridge stage.

help.verifyBody: Verification checks that written data matches the local file. The Settings toggle “Verify after burn” controls whether ROM/save burns automatically read back and compare.
help.verifyBurnDesc: When on, the app reads the cartridge back after burning and compares it with the source; turn off to skip read-back and finish faster.
help.verifySaveDesc: On the ROM page save bar, tap Verify to compare a local .sav/.srm with the cartridge save. Pick a save file and connect the flasher first.
help.updateBlocked: Flasher task running — wait before installing
help.updateDesktopOnly: Check for updates in the desktop app
